question: The base and the corresponding height of a parallelogram are 97 cm and 43 cm, respectively. The area of the parallelogram (in cm²) will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly multiply **Base** and **Height** to find the **Area**.

Area = 97 × 43

Unit digit check: 7 × 3 = 21 (Last digit must be 1).

97 × 43 = (100 − 3) × 43 = 4300 − 129 = 4171

**∴ The correct answer is 4171 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Base (b)** = 97 cm

**Height (h)** = 43 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of **Parallelogram** = **Base** × **Height**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd3a20ccf3732aa8291924aa58c1c91b4d5033242a8284daf5227a29322c857e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 97 × 43

⇒ Area = 4171 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 4171 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Parallelogram

Opposite sides are equal and parallel. Opposite angles are equal, and diagonals bisect each other.

Perimeter of a Parallelogram

Perimeter = 2 × (sum of adjacent sides) = 2(a + b).

Area using Sides and Angle

Area = a × b × sin(θ), where a and b are adjacent sides and θ is the angle between them.</p
